input.body:
label: bug
file: src/db/migrations/003_timezone.sql

The issue likely arises from how the weekly rollup email scheduling uses the user timezone in the database. The migration script "src/db/migrations/003_timezone.sql" shows the addition of a timezone column to the users table, designed to store the IANA timezone per user to decide when their week starts for the rollup email. The problem might be in how this timezone data is interpreted or used when scheduling the email, causing Sydney users to get Monday summaries on their Tuesday morning instead of Monday morning local time.
